title: Event ID 4104 for a download-cradle script block
event_type: Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational channel, EventID 4104 (Creating Scriptblock text), correlated with the same process's outbound connection

callouts.explanation: Contains both the fetch half (Net.WebClient / DownloadString) and the execute half (IEX) in one logged block, the exact fetch-and-execute pairing DET-10-01 matches on.
Confirms this script block was logged in a single 4104 event rather than split across multiple entries — the reassembly caveat called out in the DET-10-01 discussion doesn't apply to this run.
The outbound connection to the test listener, tied to the same process as the 4104 event, is what DET-10-02's network-correlation join is checking for alongside the script-block signal.

note: Conceptual, illustrative field breakdown of the Detection Test in Part 10 Section 8 — not a captured screenshot of any product interface.
